name: Hoi An Market
kicker: The market hall in the old town
summary: The market inside the ancient town, with a food hall the heritage note names for cao lầu and produce stalls along the front. UNESCO’s list text includes an open market in the property and does not name the street. The street number, the hours, and any entrance fee are check on arrival.
timeNeeded: A meal or a walk through the stalls. Exact minutes are check on arrival.
getThere: Walk the old town. The street number is check on arrival.
heroCaption: The yellow market hall, Chợ Hội An, with stalls along the front

notice.title: Hours and the street number are check on arrival
notice.body: The 2023 heritage note names the food hall and does not print a street number or a clock. Do not assume the hall is open at lantern hour.

body: The yellow hall is Chợ Hội An. A heritage note of 7 June 2023 names the food hall inside it for cao lầu, and it does not give a street number. UNESCO’s list text includes an open market inside the inscribed property and does not name the street either. The produce stalls along the front are the other half of the visit: herbs, fruit, and the baskets you walk through before you sit down.

Eat here when you want the bowl in a hall rather than on a night-market street. The night market, on the same 2023 note, is a different place, on Nguyễn Hoàng, Công nữ Ngọc Hoa, Trần Quý Cáp, and Bạch Đằng. Shop names and the reference prices on that note are not a list to follow.
No opening hour and no entrance price are printed. Both are check on arrival. Come in the daytime. The hall is not the lantern night.

figures.caption: Herb and vegetable stalls in front of the market
figures.alt: People selling baskets of herbs and vegetables at Hoi An Market

gettingThere: Walk the ancient town to the yellow hall marked Chợ Hội An. The street number is not on the heritage note. The minutes depend on your lane.

legs.heading: From the old town
legs.body: Walk to the market hall. The 2023 note does not print a street number. Ask for Chợ Hội An once you are on the river streets.

closed: No weekly closing day is printed on the heritage note.
admissionNote: No entrance price is printed on the heritage note. A bowl is a separate cost, and stall prices are not listed here. Check on arrival.
